（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D 8/197-C.121 Date 1 - 6 - 42）

Plays & Film Section. Station. File No. Date June 1, 1942.

SUBJECT:

Peking Plays Section of You Sung Travelling Group (友声旅行团) to stage Peking plays on June 7, 1942.

The Peking Plays Section of the You Sung Travelling Group, No.810 Newchwang Road, proposes to stage ten old Peking plays in the auditorium of the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, No.480 Yu Ya Ching Road, between 1 p.m. and 6 p.m. and from 7 p.m. to 11 p.m. on June 7, 1942. It is expected that some 500 persons will attend each performance. Admission will be by complimentary tickets issued by the group.

The programme in question has been examined and found to contain nothing objectionable.

Mr. Fang Ngoh Ling (方玉霖), a responsible member of the group was warned on May 30, 1942 against introducing anything undesirable into the performances.

The You Sung Travelling Group is registered with the S.M.P. (C.121).

（批：Copies sent to O. "A" & O. i/c Langa. 1/6.）

S. 1. Special Branch Station File No. Date October 11, 1941.

SUBJECT: Yeu Sung Travelling Group - to stage performances on October 12, 1941.

The Yeu Sung Travelling Group (克聲旅行團),
810 Newchwang Road, is arranging to stage theatrical
performances in the auditorium of the Ningpo
Fellow Countrymen's Association, 460 Yu Ya Ching Road,
between 1 p.m. and 6.30 p.m. and between 7 p.m. and
11.30 p.m. on October 12, 1941. It is expected
that about 300 members and their relatives will
attend each performance. Admission will be free of
charge.

The programmes will consist of 15 old style
Peiping plays, the scripts of which have been examined
and found to contain nothing of an objectionabl nature.
Fang Ngoeh-ling (方玉霖 ), one of the executives,
was interviewed at Police Headquarters at 9.30 a.m.
October 10, and warned that no politics would be
allowed during the performances.

This group is registered with the Municipal
Police with a certificate No. C.121.

A.C. (Special Branch).

SUBJECT: Yeu Sung Travelling Group - to stage theatrical performance on April 13.

The Yeu Sung Travelling Group (友聲旅行團),
810 Newchwang Road, (S.M.P. Registration Certificate
No.C-121), applies for Police permission to stage
theatrical performances in the auditorium of the
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480 Yu Ya
Ching Road, between 12.30 p.m. and 6 p.m. and between
6.30 p.m. and 11.30 p.m. on April 13, 1941. It is
expected that some 500 members and their friends and
relatives will attend each performance. Admission
will be free of charge.

The programme will consist of 13 old style
Peiping plays the scripts of which have been examined
and found to contain nothing of an objectionable nature.
Fang Ngoeh Ling (方玉霖), one of the executives,
who is a senior employee of the Tien Foong Leather
Factory, 79-81 Chekiang Road, was interviewed at
headquarters at 2.30 p.m. April 9, and warned that
nothing of a Political nature would be permitted
during the performances. He gave an assurance that
Police instructions would be strictly observed.

Dated 21st November, 1940.
Tel. 92604.

Dramatic performances.
To promote dramatic art and further friendly relations
among our members, the Chinese Dramatic Section of this Club
has decided to stage dramatic performances for the third time
at the Ningpo Residents' Association, Yu Ya Ching Road, on the
24th instant. The performances, one matinee and one night show,
will last from 1 p.m. to 11 p.m. Admittance will be free and
confined to our members. The Secretary is hereby informed of
the matter.

(Chopped) Yu Seng Tourist Club.

Enclosure: A programme giving the names of 14 classical plays.

Subject Yeu Sung Tourists' Group - Application for registration.

Made by D. I. Kao Yen Ken Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

（批：Registration approved. Rcy）

With reference to the attached application from the Yeu Sung Tourists' Group (友聲旅行團), 810 Newchwang Road, for registration, enquiries show that this is an old organization which was formed in January, 1916, for the purpose of promoting travelling. Prior to the outbreak of hostilities in 1937, the Group had a membership of 4,500 and had branches at Hangchow, Wusieh and Chinkiang. Owing to the impossibility of travelling in China consequent upon the war, the membership has shrunk to some 50 persons. The Group has three sections still functioning however, namely :-

Peiping Drama Section
Chinese String Music Section
Library Section

Each member pays $3.00 per annum as membership fee. Despite the reduced membership, the Group is carrying on with funds previously accumulated which amount to some $30,000.

The following are the executives in charge of the group :-

Yao Yuan Kan (姚元幹),
a clerk of the Hongkong and Shanghai Bank, 12 The Bund.

Han Tseng Han (韓振漢),
a chartered accountant at 810 Newchwang Road.

Yoong Bei chum (榮培欽),
Compadore of the Shanghai Tug and Lighter Company,

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER JULY 1940 DIVISIONS）
